title: EAGLE ISLAND CELL 2 IMPROVEMENTS
description: W912PM26BA008 The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Wilmington District requires a contract to perform work of the Eagle Island Cell 2 disposal area. The project includes work at Cell 2 of the Government owned Eagle Island Confined Disposal Facility (CDF) also referred to as the Dredged Material Disposal Area. The work to improve Cell 2 consists of: using existing coffer berms around spillways 4 and 5, as well as the interior of Cell 2 as borrow, raise approximately 2,000 linear feet of the low spots on the west portion of Cell 2 to EL. 46 feet NAVD88 where crest heights range from approximately EL. 37 feet NAVD88 to EL. 45 feet NAVD88 and corresponds with approximate Stations 190+00 to 210+00; raising a few bents of the timber cribbing structures associated with the outfall pipe for spillway 4; repairs to straighten spillways 4 and 5 will consist of deconstructing the riser structures, removing the footing, removing the catwalk, re-grading the bump-out to a 3H:1V slope, prepping the subgrade, pouring a 16-inch footing and reconstructing the riser structure. This solicitation is a Total Small Business Set Aside. The contract issued will be Firm Fixed Price. The Magnitude of Construction of this project is between $5,000,000.00 and $10,000,000.00. This solicitation will be issued in electronic format only and will be available on or about 12 August 2026. The bid opening date will be specified in the solicitation when it is issued. No additional media (CD-ROM, floppy disks, facsimiles, etc.) will be provided. Paper copies of this solicitation will not be available. Other methods of requesting a package will not be honored. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 237990 � Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction and the size standard is $45,000,000.00. General Work Requirements: Sub-Annex 1502000 Facility Investment The intent of Facility Investment is to specify the requirements for Sustainment, Restoration, and Modernization (SRM) sub-functions only. The Facility Investment requirements within this sub-annex primarily consist of infrastructure sustainment and minimal restoration and modernization work. Sustainment is the maintenance and repair necessary to keep an inventory of facilities and other assets in good working order. Restoration and modernization normally consists of major rehabilitation and capital improvements that is accomplished through other USMC programs. Some major repair, minor construction and stand-alone demolition may be accomplished as part of Facility Investment. The Contractor shall perform maintenance, repair, alteration, demolition and minor construction for the following: Building and Structures � to include interior and exterior finishes, plumbing (includes backflow prevention devices), grease traps, roofing, foundation, structural components, cathodic protection systems, tanks, POL system, pipelines, relamping, converters, Building Systems -HVAC, Direct Digital Control (DDC), Emergency Management Control System (EMCS), Vertical Transportation Equipment (VTE), intrusion detection systems, bridge and jib cranes, boilers, Unfired Pressure Vessels (UPV), compressed air systems, potable water (including backflow prevention devices), wastewater, and electrical. Sub-Annex 1503020 Pest Control The contractor shall provide pest control services to prevent and control nuisance, structural, turf and ornamental, and medical arthropod and vertebrate pests, including but not limited to cockroaches, termites, ants, fleas, bed bugs, silverfish, stored product pests, mosquitoes, mice, rats, bats, feral dogs and cats and other vertebrates, bees, wasps, pigeons, and nuisance birds. All sources for generating electrical power for utilities, e.g., boilers, wind, solar, gas, etc. Annex 1700000 Base Support Vehicle and Equipment The intent of BSVE is to specify the requirements for a transportation program consisting of vehicles, equipment maintenance and repairs. This requirement is for the repair of the rotary manifold for a John Deere 85G Excavator which requires removal, inspection and reconditioning for Cuyahoga Valley National Park. Murphy Tractor is the only John Deere Certified Dealer that is close to the park in Cleveland/ Akron and the surrounding areas. The rotary manifold assembly (10-port configuration) and associated seal kits are proprietary components designed to OEM specifications. Compatibility, warranty protection, and operational integrity necessitate procurement of John Deere-approved parts and qualified service support. Substituting non-OEM components may compromise system performance, increase failure risk, and create liability exposure. If the park outsourced this requirement to another Certified John Deere Dealer that is further away this would add excessive additional cost for reassembly of the machine and due to transportation costs. Additionally, this equipment must be urgently repaired in order to support park operations for the maintenance of park railroad tracks which could be impeded due to mudslide or other hazards. Failure to repair this equipment in a timely manner could endanger park staff and guests. Due to the above, sole-sourcing to Murphy Tractor & Equipment Co, Inc ensures the most expedient and compliant resolution to these urgent repairs. Murphy Tractor is the only John Deere Certified Dealer that is close to the park in Cleveland/ Akron and the surrounding areas. The rotary manifold assembly (10-port configuration) and associated seal kits are proprietary components designed to OEM specifications. Compatibility, warranty protection, and operational integrity necessitate procurement of John Deere-approved parts and qualified service support. Substituting non-OEM components may compromise system performance, increase failure risk, and create liability exposure. If the park outsourced this requirement to another Certified John Deere Dealer that is further away this would add excessive additional cost for reassembly of the machine and due to transportation costs. Additionally, this equipment must be urgently repaired in order to support park operations for the maintenance of park railroad tracks which could be impeded due to mudslide or other hazards. Failure to repair this equipment in a timely manner could endanger park staff and guests. Due to the above, sole-sourcing to Murphy Tractor & Equipment Co, Inc ensures the most expedient and compliant resolution to these urgent repairs. title: Automated Background Investigation System (ABIS) Maintenance and Support
description: The CFPB, PSO, requires continued contractor support for the operation, maintenance and enhancement of the Automated Background Investigation System (ABIS). ABIS serves as an established personnel security system supporting the administrative processing, tracking, management and transmission of personnel security and investigative information in support of background investigation and personnel vetting activities. The objective of this requirement is to ensure the continued availability, reliability, security and functionality of ABIS while enabling the system to adapt to evolving CFPB operational needs and Government wide personnel vetting policies, standards, technologies and external systems. Contractor support shall include ongoing system maintenance and technical support; configuration and software updates; maintenance of existing interfaces and data exchanges; and the development and implementation of approved enhancements and modifications necessary to support CFPB business requirements and maintain compatibility with changes to CFPB and external Federal systems, processes and requirements.
